scope: Actual current common-worker engine, D2PRL operation only. Segmented full JPEG source, fixed448/40/seed22 native model, all full source-coordinate planes checked; three original zones at96MP. No batch-chain recreation, completed-model-output shortcut, universal-device or RSS claim. One30MP A/B pair is functional evidence, not repeated speed qualification.
portability: Ephemeral origins and local source/depot paths normalized; numerical values, array hashes and module identities preserved. Original detailed local report size/SHA recorded.

baselineOverride.scope: Only d2prlRuntime evaluator/roles default arguments differ; all other runtime/source/model/image bytes shared.

comparison.reason: One paired functional observation; not a repeated isolated speed qualification.

patchmatchPool.timingSemantics: Wall durations including waits; concurrent worker/copy/gather totals are not additive. Optional reclamation is policy accounting after a reservation refusal, not evidence of allocator failure or physical RAM release. Descriptor bytes are native payload extents within the reported heap, not an extra backing. Backings are registered extents, not process RSS or GPU utilization.

execution.timingSemantics: Phase elapsed wall milliseconds include waits, retries and phase callbacks; failed attempts accumulate across checkpoint resumes. Pool service times overlap and are not additive CPU time.
